record.title: Historia ecclesiastica gentis Anglorum
record.author: Bede the Venerable
record.notes: Early medieval ecclesiastical history and political memory. Initial body candidate is A. M. Sellar's 1907 English translation from Project Gutenberg; a verified Latin counterpart remains missing.
record.coverage_notes: The authority record is scoped to Bede's Ecclesiastical History. Any initial English admission would cover the complete Sellar 1907 translated work, not a verified Latin edition, English/Latin equivalence, or Bede's complete surviving corpus.

proposed_body.work_title: Historia ecclesiastica gentis Anglorum / Bede's Ecclesiastical History of England
proposed_body.edition_label: Project Gutenberg ebook 38326; A. M. Sellar, A Revised Translation, George Bell and Sons, London, 1907; released 2011-12-17, updated 2020-06-17
proposed_body.license_notes: Project Gutenberg marks ebook 38326 public domain in the USA and includes its license and non-US jurisdiction warning in the unmodified text. Admission would preserve the complete Gutenberg wrapper and make no rights claim outside the United States.
proposed_body.coverage_notes: The unmodified Gutenberg body contains Sellar's front matter and all five books through Book V, chapter XXIV, plus notes, index, wrapper, and license. Complete-work applies only to this named English edition; it does not establish Latin equivalence or source-authority completeness.

proposed_import_arguments.work_title: Historia ecclesiastica gentis Anglorum / Bede's Ecclesiastical History of England

required_gates.requirement: Add the exact located source record to library-registry.json and validate it before any body dry-run.
Accept public-domain as the registry posture for the United States while preserving Gutenberg's non-US warning and full license wrapper.
Immediately before dry-run and admission, confirm SHA-256 and byte count still match the inspection receipt.
Run Library Import with --check against the exact source file, body ID, metadata, license, and coverage arguments.
Only a separately authorized non-check import may copy the body into the configured private text store and mutate the registry.
Run library validate, render-index --check, verify-texts, and tests/test_archive_library.py; confirm the Medieval index is reconciled under the separately authorized implementation contract.

maturity_projection.notes: Admission alone must not mark the source reviewed or verified. A verified Latin body and an explicit cross-edition relationship are required before considering Level 5.

non_authorizations: No copy or move into the private library text store
No available, verified, or reviewed status change
No staging, commit, push, Archive ingestion, or publication
